title: A personal vault with the storage place you choose
description: The state of the local copy and of the sync is visible during ordinary use.

blocks.text: Your own cloud does not free you from version conflicts and dropped connections. A person needs to know where the last edit was saved.

quote.text: We’ve been using pwSafe with Dropbox for instantaneous synchronization for several years now. Works like a charm!

blocks.text: Support the chosen storage methods, show the changes that have not been sent and the recovery available. Test how it works with no network and in a conflict.
Do not promise security on the strength of the cloud you chose. The protection model and recovery have to be designed and tested together with the sync.
